usedFor: Raisely runs fundraising campaigns, and Google Contacts receives each new supporter through “Create Contact” when “New Profile” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Profile” in Raisely, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A profile created in a campaign becomes a saved contact, so supporters are easy to find later.

watchOut: “New Campaign” in Raisely is polling, so a template built on it runs after a scheduled check.
